# Charles Jackson

> Engineer and founder building agentic systems — software that takes a goal and
> carries it out (planning, using tools, acting without a person steering every
> step) — and the companies around them.

## About

Charles Jackson is an Agentic Systems Engineer and founder. He builds autonomous
AI agent products and the companies around them, focused on making autonomy
dependable enough to trust with real work. Remote / Vancouver.

## Focus areas

- Agent orchestration: multi-step agents, tool use, planning loops, and the guardrails that keep them on task
- LLM systems: retrieval, evals, structured output, and pipelines that stay correct as models change
- Full-stack product: TypeScript, React, edge & serverless — interfaces that make autonomy legible to people
- Creative engineering: generative and real-time graphics — canvas, shaders, and motion

## Selected work

- [Predictive](https://predictive.company): agentic software company
- [MicroHabitat](https://microhabitat.com): urban farming at city scale
- [MyUrbanFarm](https://myurbanfarm.ai): the platform behind the farms
- [Direct AI Agents](https://directaiagents.com): learn to direct AI coding agents
- [Cursuum](https://cursuum.com): AI-powered scheduling
- [Crucible](https://crucible.bet): provably-fair casino and duels
